title: Visual Direction Lock and UI Inventory

normalPlayAssertions: No normal-player More gateway or legacy Regions, Engineer, Logistics or Intel route is visible after BG12D.
Only the status strip, minimal navigation and tabletop rail persist around the idle board.
At most one contextual interaction surface is visible at once.
At most one coach mark or transient toast is visible at once.
No persistent or contextual surface intersects another outside its reserved edge region.
The document has no more than two pixels of horizontal overflow.
The idle map meets the desktop or compact map-size budget.
Normal-play screenshots contain no legacy operational workspace panel.
Critical state remains legible without relying only on colour or motion.
diagnosticsAssertions: The diagnostics route is entered only by the explicit ?legacy-ui=1 query.
Historical probes that still require legacy workspaces opt into the diagnostics route deliberately.
The diagnostics route never becomes the default or a normal-player navigation destination.

legacyProbeDependencies.migration: BG12D: launch with ?legacy-ui=1 before asserting legacy specialist surfaces
BG12D: specialist sweep runs only against ?legacy-ui=1; normal-play assertions test absence instead

surfaces.currentPurpose: 2.5D Central Front board and camera
surfaces.reason: The accepted map is the product centre and already owns the protected renderer lifecycle.

surfaces.currentPurpose: retained physical task-group pieces
surfaces.reason: Physical formations are already the correct board-game metaphor.

surfaces.currentPurpose: round, seat, player, CA, phase, activation and campaign status
surfaces.finalRemoval: current large shell removed in BG12E
surfaces.reason: The information remains authoritative but the current box consumes too much vertical attention.

surfaces.currentPurpose: legacy resolver and operational header compatibility
surfaces.reason: It duplicates board status/action concepts and currently sits above the board at z-index 36.

surfaces.currentPurpose: Board, Forces, Combat, Cards, Rules & Save plus legacy navigation
surfaces.target: Board, Forces, Rules / Save and Settings only
surfaces.finalRemoval: legacy navigation structure removed in BG12D; minimal replacement remains
surfaces.reason: Navigation remains useful but Combat/Cards are interactions and legacy specialist routes are not product destinations.

surfaces.currentPurpose: focuses the fixed strategic card hand
surfaces.target: cards handled directly in the tabletop rail
surfaces.reason: Cards should be physical components, not a navigation destination.

surfaces.currentPurpose: opens Regions, Engineer, Logistics and Intel
surfaces.finalRemoval: BG12D normal play; BG12O4 code deletion
surfaces.reason: The old simulation workspaces are no longer product requirements.

surfaces.currentPurpose: quick commands, selected formation and map-side operational context
surfaces.target: one contextual formation/action card only when required
surfaces.finalRemoval: duplicate operational context removed by BG12H
surfaces.reason: Permanent selected-formation sidebars duplicate board selection and crowd the map.

surfaces.currentPurpose: persistent legends, layers, modes and terrain controls
surfaces.target: small utilities revealed only when relevant
surfaces.finalRemoval: large permanent boxes removed in BG12I
surfaces.reason: The board should carry state directly through markers, pieces and restrained labels.

surfaces.currentPurpose: selected piece, movement and activation actions
surfaces.reason: Its authoritative action logic is useful but it should appear contextually rather than persist at the right edge.

surfaces.currentPurpose: target selection, D20 preview/result and combat feedback
surfaces.target: compact attack preview plus physical dice tray
surfaces.finalRemoval: fixed form-like panel removed by BG12H
surfaces.reason: Combat rules remain authoritative but the presentation should become tactile and contextual.

surfaces.currentPurpose: fixed strategic card grid, targets and play feedback
surfaces.target: physical deck stacks, discard and hand in the tabletop rail
surfaces.reason: Authoritative cards remain, but the current grid reads as a management form rather than a hand of cards.

surfaces.currentPurpose: recover, engineer and logistics support actions
surfaces.reason: Support actions stay authoritative but should not occupy a permanent separate panel.

surfaces.currentPurpose: pass eligibility and reason feedback
surfaces.target: inline reason in the active contextual card
surfaces.reason: The feedback matters but does not justify another persistent surface.

surfaces.currentPurpose: fixed next-useful-action guidance
surfaces.target: small coach mark or contextual hint
surfaces.reason: Guidance remains useful but must not compete with the board.

surfaces.currentPurpose: fixed Rules button and floating rules reference
surfaces.finalRemoval: standalone floating panel removed in BG12K
surfaces.reason: Rules remain accessible but should be off-board depth, not persistent board chrome.

surfaces.currentPurpose: fixed Guide button and multi-step floating card
surfaces.target: coach marks anchored to real controls/map state
surfaces.finalRemoval: current floating guide card removed in BG12J
surfaces.reason: The onboarding logic is retained but the window-like presentation obscures too much of the board.

surfaces.currentPurpose: audio, motion, accessibility and presentation settings
surfaces.finalRemoval: never; only the current shell changes
surfaces.reason: The settings system is useful and already authoritative for accessibility/audio preferences.

surfaces.currentPurpose: formation roster and organisation inspection
surfaces.finalRemoval: full-screen command workspace removed in BG12K
surfaces.reason: Force inspection remains useful depth but should not replace the tabletop.

surfaces.currentPurpose: campaign file actions, rules/save and legacy campaign controls
surfaces.finalRemoval: legacy campaign workspace removed in BG12K/BG12O4
surfaces.reason: Save/reload remains essential; operational campaign controls do not.

surfaces.currentPurpose: operational political/territory management
surfaces.reason: Historical probes still inspect it, but board control state replaces it in the product.

surfaces.currentPurpose: operational repair/build/interdiction management
surfaces.reason: Board support/cards replace its strategic meaning; historical probes still inspect the surface.

surfaces.currentPurpose: operational supply allocation and priorities
surfaces.reason: Board support/cards replace this management UI; historical probes still inspect it.

surfaces.currentPurpose: operational intelligence dashboards
surfaces.reason: Board markers/cards should carry strategically relevant information instead.

surfaces.currentPurpose: old operational Combat/Operations command cards

surfaces.currentPurpose: specialist operational dashboards

surfaces.currentPurpose: old operational combat-report workspace

surfaces.owner: App command topbar / legacy simulation state

surfaces.reason: Board rounds, activations and Command Actions are authoritative.
